name: The Undead Coming (2026)
desc:
🧟 The Undead Coming is an action-packed round survival game where you must endure blasting through countless hordes of undead zombies!

Version 1.1 is now out.
- New changelogs in-game!

❗ Not affiliated with unofficial spinoff titles such as "The Undead Coming: Armageddon". ❗
This is an official continuation of TUC 2021. Please do not ask us for your data or features from Armageddon.

Original place of this remake was created 5/7/2023.
